name: pyramid-task
description: Plan demonstrable increments, assure changes, and preserve causal intent chronicles for humans and agents.

interface.shortDescription: Demonstrable delivery with evidence-backed task graphs.
interface.longDescription: Turn an intent into the smallest honest ladder of runnable or otherwise demonstrable increments, establish each increment through explicit audit proof, and observe human-readable progress from the current intent to the next required evidence. Preserve completed work as append-only causal chronicles, trace code paths and commits to their implementation rationale, and give agents bounded replay context without mixing old work into the active graph. Fact-check plans, derive conflict-safe parallel batches, baseline existing systems, map change impact, preserve durable handoffs, and drill into technical execution and assurance when needed.
defaultPrompt: Plan this intent as demonstrable increments.
Show current intent progress and next proof.
Explain why this code changed from intent history.
